title: Surreal Gothic Castle
description: A monochromatic line art scene depicts a winding river flowing from jagged mountains through fields of purple flowers toward a dark castle adorned with multiple expressive human faces. In the foreground, a glowing crystal ball shows two figures, a person stands on skeletal steps, paper boats float on the river, and a large moon with multiple faces and dripping icicles hangs in the starry sky.
prompt: Surreal black and white line art illustration of a dark gothic castle covered in large expressive human faces, situated beside a winding black river with paper boats floating on it, leading from jagged mountains through vast fields of purple lavender flowers with glowing yellow accents, in the foreground a large glowing crystal ball with two figures inside wrapped by a dragon tail, a traveler with backpack standing on steps made of bones, above a large detailed moon with multiple faces and icicle drips in a dark starry sky
